prompt: Write a single, self-contained prompt for a text-to-image model that has never heard of Chinese memes, so that it draws a giraffe version of the "大笑奶龙" (Laughing Nailong / 奶蛙) meme. Output only the prompt.
answer: A deliberately crude, low-effort internet reaction-image doodle of a chubby cartoon baby giraffe laughing hysterically — drawn as if in MS Paint by someone in a hurry, then re-saved until slightly crunchy: flat bucket-filled colors with zero shading or gradients, thick wobbly uneven black outlines that don't quite meet, jagged aliased edges, oversaturated palette, plain flat white background, square framing, character centered and filling most of the frame. The giraffe is a stubby chibi blob: an enormous round head fused almost directly onto a fat pear-shaped body with barely any neck, bright banana-yellow fur covered in a few big irregular orange-brown polygon patches, two tiny knob-tipped horn stubs on top of the head, small leaf-shaped ears sticking out sideways, two comically short stubby arms flung upward in delight, two tiny hoof-tipped legs, a little tufted tail. Its head is tilted back and to one side, and its mouth is stretched into a gigantic cavernous open laugh that swallows the lower two-thirds of the face — a huge wide grinning cavern of dark maroon-red interior with a big flat pink tongue and a row of four or five simple blocky white square teeth along the top edge, the mouth outline wobbling asymmetrically. Eyes are squeezed shut into two thick upward-curving black crescent arcs, no pupils, no nose detail, tiny pink oval blush smudges on the cheeks. Two or three crude blue teardrop shapes fly off the sides of the head, plus a few short black straight motion lines around the body to suggest violent shaking laughter. Overall vibe: unhinged, gleeful, mocking, ugly-cute, intentionally bad-on-purpose sticker art. No text, no letters, no watermark, no signature, no realistic rendering, no 3D, no smooth anime polish.
